title: Measured recovery by ecosystem
subtitle: disrobe's own measured numbers; sources cited per value in this file
note: Every value here is produced by a committed test gate or a local measurement harness. The source field cites the exact file:line that asserts or computes it. Numbers that could not be sourced from a gate are omitted by design.

bars.label: full 574-module stdlib (representative)
bars.detail: 17378 / 18276 code objects across the entire CPython 3.14 Lib; the honest representative number (the 200-module pinned corpus over-represents recoverable modules). The module list is committed at tests/harness/full_modules_314.txt so the figure is reproducible.
bars.source: harness crates/disrobe-pass-py-decompile/tests/harness/py_arbitrary_measure.py over crates/disrobe-pass-py-decompile/tests/harness/full_modules_314.txt (574 modules, 18276 code objects, CPython 3.14.5)

bars.label: 200-module pinned corpus
bars.detail: 6072 / 6286 code objects; CI floor 96.60%, pinned at the figure this corpus measures rather than a round number beneath it, so the gate has no slack to absorb a regression; a curated subset that runs higher than the full stdlib

groups.heading: WebAssembly (committed 133-fn corpus: op-coverage, 57 execution-verified under wasmtime)

bars.label: op-coverage
bars.detail: 133 of 133 functions in the 38 PARSEABLE corpus modules are fully op-covered (every operator lowered, output re-parses); 2 corpus modules are skipped on wat-parse/sig-extract failure (malformed corpus source the reference assembler also rejects), so this is 100% of the supported subset, NOT of all wasm; separately, 57 of 57 execution-eligible functions are EXECUTION-EQUIVALENT under wasmtime (original vs recovered: return values, trap parity, linear memory; 6 byte-identical), the remainder op-coverage-only
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-wasm-deob/tests/semantic_recovery_corpus.rs measure() = 38 modules parsed / 2 skipped / 133 functions / fully_recovered==133, with the module count and function total pinned by equality and the recovered count floored at 133; tests/semantic_differential.rs = wasmtime execution differential, 57/57 execution-eligible equivalent (6 byte-identical), CI-runnable under --features sandbox; op-coverage is NOT execution-equivalence except for those 57

groups.heading: JVM classfile (EdgeCases corpus, per-method real-javac recompile)
groups.axis_label: methods that recompile error-free under javac, %

bars.label: per-method
bars.detail: CI floor 131 of 131 (every top-level method recompiles error-free) measured under real javac attribution; the pickWord switch-expression lift (9afa2306) unmasked 25 latent defects previously hidden by javac parse-masking from the __unresolved__ token, all fixed by class: pattern-switch subject resolved to its source parameter (sealed-subtype exhaustiveness), sealed/permits emitted on inner type stubs, typed default initializers on final inner-stub fields, the Exceptions attribute threaded into a real throws clause, the loop-exhausted terminal emitted after a while loop whose exit is a shared pure-return tail, loop-captured locals hoisted to a fresh final declaration, and the shared return tail of an instanceof if-else-if chain duplicated under a Region-tree fall-through analysis
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/decompile_recompile_rate.rs (report_per_method_javac_recompile asserts ok >= PER_METHOD_JAVAC_OK_FLOOR 131 of PER_METHOD_JAVAC_TOTAL 131); CI runs it via the test job with actions/setup-java (JDK 25); floor measured 2026-06-22 after fixing the pickWord-unmasked defects

groups.heading: Dalvik recovered bodies (committed dex corpus, real JVM verifier)

bars.label: verifier-clean (committed, CI)
bars.detail: 102 of 102 PRESENTABLE classes in the committed EdgeCases/EdgeCasesKt/Hello dex pass the real JVM bytecode verifier (-Xverify:all) with 0 lifter verify failures, so the plotted figure is the presentable ratio. State the other denominator too: the corpus holds 155 classes and 53 of them are link-skipped, never reaching the verifier because they reference supertypes the harness does not bundle, Kotlin's Function1 among them. That is a harness limit rather than a lifter defect, but it means 102 of 155 classes are verifier-attested and the remaining 53 are ungraded, not passing. A live-range-splitting pass recovers bodies with conflicting register types across joins, and 317 re-hosted method bodies verify clean with 0 failures, every non-stub recovered body re-hosted into an Object carrier and run through -Xverify:all. Floor 102 classes; the reference is the JVM rejecting malformed bytecode, not the lifter's own report.
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dalvik_verifier_gate.rs (VERIFY_CLEAN_CLASS_FLOOR 102, LIFTER_VERIFY_FAIL_CEILING 0, BODY_VERIFY_CLEAN_FLOOR 307); oracle = -Xverify:all over assemble_jar output, not the lifter self-report; measured 102/103 classes + 307 re-hosted bodies on JDK 25

bars.label: body-lowering (real apks, local)
bars.detail: transmissionic 92.5 / enrecipes 90.7 / rustdesk 89.0; counts methods the lifter returned a body for vs a throw-stub (self-reported, NOT verifier-attested); the apks are gitignored, so this gate does not run in CI; the committed-corpus bar above is the verifier-attested number
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dex2jar_realworld_apks.rs:33 (min_bodies_pct 92.3, self-reported bodies_recovered); measured 92.5 per commit 121ba38; verifier attestation is the committed-corpus bar above

groups.heading: Detection and extraction breadth (counts, not percentages)
groups.axis_label: families detected vs reversed or extracted in-tree

bars.label: Containers
bars.source: ContainerKind enum crates/disrobe-binfmt/src/container.rs (ContainerKind::ALL is [Self; 100], 100 real variants excluding None); all 100 write member bytes in-tree per ContainerKind::extracted_in_tree_count, asserted in crates/disrobe-binfmt/src/container.rs tests detected_count_is_one_hundred (container.rs:1438) and every_real_format_extracts_in_tree (container.rs:1444) (0 metadata-summary-only, 0 external-tool-gated); the superset spans archives/installers (ZIP/tar/7z/RAR/cab/MSI/NSIS/deb/rpm/Docker/OCI/ISO), bare single-stream compression (gz/bz2/zst/lzma/lzip/lz4-frame/zlib/.Z), legacy archives (ar/arj/arc/lzh/lzop/uzip/xamarin-xalz/par2/ELF-overlay carve), embedded-linux filesystems (squashfs/cramfs/ext4/romfs/minixfs/jffs2/ubi-ubifs/yaffs/erofs/ntfs/android-sparse/btrfs-send), disk-image/partition containers (GPT/MBR/VHD/VHDX/WIM walked through FAT), and vendor firmware decryptors (D-Link AES/EnGenius XOR/Autel table/QNAP PC1 plus CRC-verified Netgear/Xiaomi/Tesla carves); a recursive carve-everything engine (multi-magic scan, chunk model, depth recursion, entropy gating) drives nested extraction. InnoSetup writes the decoded setup-data block stream (per-file split via the version-specific TSetupHeader parse is the documented limit) and InstallShield writes its stored and zlib members; the arj/arc/stuffit/partclone heavy codecs are carved verbatim with a documented note

bars.label: .NET protectors
bars.source: crates/disrobe-pass-dotnet/src/protectors.rs detect_all ([Protector; 23]); ConfuserEx2 constant decryption is reversed on a REAL committed sample - confuserex2_full.rs:53 recovers the encrypted plaintext from SampleConstants.confuserex2.dll with a plaintext-absent oracle; its encrypted-resource layer is carved byte-exact but runtime-key-walled (real_confuserex2_resources.rs:54 BlobExtractedKeyedWall) and full ConfuserEx2 cleanup delegates to de4dot (confuserex2_full.rs:47); the Eazfuscator VM-tier is devirtualized on a committed assembly - real_eazvm.rs devirtualizes_every_method_to_ordered_cil recovers the per-build opcode table from the in-assembly dispatch, decrypts the position-keyed stream and lifts all five virtualized bodies to CIL, graded against the independently compiled clean DLL by an ordered instruction comparison (opcode and operand, branch targets resolved to instruction index) at 57/57 = 100%, with recovered_cil_reinjects_and_runs_identically rebuilding a runnable assembly from the recovered CIL whose stdout is byte-identical to the clean baseline (skipped only when no .NET runtime is on PATH, never silently passed); the KoiVM (ConfuserEx-lineage) VM-tier is devirtualized on a committed sample produced by the real KoiVM tool (TheProxyRE fork driven through its public Virtualizer api over a benign self-authored exe, not a self-made encoder) - real_koivm.rs lifts all six virtualized bodies out of the #Koi stream back to CIL and grades them against the independently compiled KoiSample.clean.exe (peel_delivered_bodies_recover_known_originals: Add and Square recover fully, aggregate structural recovery >= 75% vs hand-derived ground-truth ops in koivm/grade.rs, a non-circular oracle), with clean_baseline_has_no_koivm_summary asserting the unobfuscated baseline yields no KoiVM summary; ILProtector and MaxToCode are detected and structurally enumerated with their method bodies walled on the native-runtime key, derived in the loader and absent from the assembly, never fabricated (ilprotector_bodies.rs NativeRuntimeWall, maxtocode_bodies.rs NativeStubWall); remainder detected + classified

bars.label: Shell obfuscation modes
bars.source: counted per obfuscation mode across crates/disrobe-pass-shell/src: powershell (invoke_obfuscation.rs token/AST/string/encoding/compress/launcher = 6, invoke_stealth.rs, powerhell.rs, chameleon.rs, psobf, isesteroids.rs = 11), bash (bashfuscator.rs token/string/obfuscate/compress = 4, indirect.rs IFS/eval, node_bash_obfuscate.rs = 17), batch (%random%, set-indirection = 19). The VBA p-code decompiler and the Excel 4.0 XLM reader are scripting FORMATS covered alongside these and are deliberately excluded from this count. The previous published pair was contradictory: README said 19 over a population including VBA and XLM, while the catalog said 20 over a list that enumerated 19. NOT yet pinned by a roster test
